title: Sales Call Analyzer
tagline: Transcribe a finished call, extract sentiment, deal stage and objections, and write the result to your CRM.
description: When a call ends the recording is transcribed with Otter.ai, an LLM extracts sentiment, deal stage and objections, and the CRM deal is updated with a follow-up task and a log row. A confidence check sends low-confidence results to an error log instead of writing them to the CRM. Optional Slack alert. Two alternative editions ship: HubSpot and Pipedrive.
